note: Warp NPCs from 'warp' and 'warp2' lines, and duplicates of them, in the order rAthena loads them from npc/<mode>/scripts_main.conf. A player who walks onto a cell within xs and ys of x,y goes to to_map at to_x,to_y (npc_touch_areanpc); warps earlier in the list win. warp2 also works for hidden players. state is enabled unless the line sets warp(DISABLED), warp(HIDDEN) or warp(CLOAKED); only enabled warps show (sprite JT_WARPNPC, 45) and work. to_loaded says whether the target map is in the map server's map list. script_warp_npcs counts script NPCs with a warp sprite, which need the script engine and are not listed.
